nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner stored in Owned; written by Owned constructor and acceptOwnership, read by onlyOwner via msg.sender comparison.
Pending owner address stored in Owned; written by transferOwnership and acceptOwnership, read by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to 'DRAKE' in the DRAKE constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'DRAKE' in the DRAKE constructor.
Public token decimals (uint8), set to 18 in the DRAKE constructor.
Total token supply; set in the DRAKE constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; read by balanceOf/transfer/transferFrom and written by transfer/transferFrom and the DRAKE constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom and read by allowance/transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; requires b <= a then computes c = a - b, guarding underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender, i.e. the deployer becomes owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner by writing newOwner = _newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and promotes newOwner to owner, resetting newOwner to address(0).
DRAKE() constructor; initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the full supply to the hard-coded deployer address.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], a raw uint subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-value reset guard.
Spends from allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd, emitting Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes the untrusted spender contract's receiveApproval, performing an external call with user-supplied 'data'.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function making an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to arbitrary token contracts.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance/allowance keying and as the from argument of external calls.
uint addition c = a + b in safeAdd followed by require(c >= a); overflow is guarded but the arithmetic is the sensitive operation.
uint subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a); underflow-sensitive arithmetic.
uint multiplication c = a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
uint division c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0) to prevent division by zero.
Raw uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply() with no SafeMath wrapper.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract with attacker-controlled data.
External call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) whose return value is trusted.
Unconditional revert() executed by the payable fallback function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited account in transfer, indexing balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender keys allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance and is forwarded as the 'from' argument of receiveApproval.
The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before allowing ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the owner.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is passed as an argument into the untrusted external receiveApproval call.
Owned constructor writes the deployer address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes its argument into the newOwner state variable.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the transferOwnership body and then into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable, a privileged ownership change.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
DRAKE constructor assigns the symbol string.
DRAKE constructor assigns the name string.
DRAKE constructor assigns decimals = 18.
DRAKE constructor sets the total supply value.
DRAKE constructor credits the whole supply into balances of the hard-coded deployer address.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the raw subtraction in totalSupply().
The unguarded subtraction result is returned as the total supply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and subtracts from balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and subtracts from balances[from].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before calling out.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the updated 'from' and 'to' balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the allowed mapping.
safeAdd performs the guarded uint addition operation.
safeSub performs the guarded uint subtraction operation.
safeMul performs the guarded uint multiplication operation.
safeDiv performs the guarded uint division operation.
Parameter a feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a feeds the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b feeds the division inside safeDiv.
Local c receives the addition result in safeAdd.
Local c receives the subtraction result in safeSub.
Local c receives the multiplication result in safeMul.
Local c receives the division result in safeDiv.
Parameter 'to' is the credited account in transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount moved in transfer.
Parameter 'spender' keys the allowance written by approve.
Parameter 'tokens' is the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter 'from' is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is the mapping key read by balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner is the outer mapping key read by allowance.
Parameter spender is the inner mapping key read by allowance.
Parameter 'spender' supplies the allowance key and the target contract of the callback.
Parameter 'tokens' is the approved amount and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
Attacker-controlled 'data' bytes are forwarded unvalidated into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the arbitrary contract used as the external call target.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
transfer delegates the credit side to safeAdd.
transfer delegates the debit side to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates balance credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval invocation after updating state.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches the arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call.
The fallback function executes the unconditional revert.
The untrusted external contract invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall or the token contract during the call.
The arbitrary token contract being called back may re-enter transferAnyERC20Token or other token functions.

Parameter b exists only to feed the safeMul arithmetic and should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Parameter a exists only to feed the safeDiv arithmetic and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
Parameter b exists only to feed the safeDiv arithmetic and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
_newOwner is a plain forwarding parameter of transferOwnership and carries no independent semantics.
The recipient parameter only parameterizes the transfer balances update.
The amount parameter only parameterizes the transfer SafeMath operations.
The spender parameter only keys the allowance mapping inside approve.
The tokens parameter only supplies the allowance value inside approve.
The from parameter only selects the debited balance slot inside transferFrom.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance slot inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter only supplies the amount for the SafeMath calls inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is merely the mapping lookup key of balanceOf.
tokenOwner is merely the outer mapping lookup key of allowance.
spender is merely the inner mapping lookup key of allowance.
spender supplies the allowance key and the target of the external callback and has no standalone meaning.
tokens only supplies the approved amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is attacker-controlled input forwarded into the external call and should be absorbed by approveAndCall.
tokenAddress only selects the arbitrary external contract target of the privileged call.
tokens only supplies the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
